To remove an employee from your HackerRank hiring account, you have two main options:

**Option 1: Lock the User Account (Recommended)**
This prevents the employee from accessing the platform while keeping the account available for reuse:

1. Log in to your HackerRank for Work account
2. Select your profile icon (top-right corner) and choose Teams Management
3. Go to the Users tab
4. Select the employee and click More, then Lock
5. In the Lock Users dialog, select a user to transfer resource ownership (tests, interviews, etc. will be transferred to this user)
6. Click Confirm

The locked user cannot log in and will see an error message if they attempt to access the platform.

**Option 2: Remove from Teams**
If the employee belongs to specific teams, you can remove them from those teams:

1. Go to Teams Management > Teams tab
2. Select the team where you want to remove the employee
3. Click the Users tab
4. Click the delete icon next to the employee's name in the Action column
5. Confirm the removal

Note: If the employee belongs to only one team and you remove them from it, they will be locked out of the platform.

Both options ensure the employee loses access to your hiring account. Choose the first option if you want to preserve their resources for transfer or future reuse.
